target.title: fix: estimate DeepSeek spend when API reports zero cost
target.body:
Closes #97047

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running DeepSeek V4 models would see Control UI Spend stay at zero when the DeepSeek API recorded nonzero token usage but returned `usage.cost.total: 0`.

## Why This Change Was Made

When transcript scanning sees nonzero token usage, a recorded zero provider total, and known positive model pricing, OpenClaw now recomputes the session cost from pricing instead of treating the provider total as authoritative. The durable usage-cost cache version is bumped so previously cached zero-spend summaries are rebuilt under the corrected semantics.

## User Impact

DeepSeek V4 usage with known pricing now contributes to session and Control UI spend totals instead of appearing as confident zero-cost activity. Unknown/all-zero pricing still surfaces as missing cost rather than guessing spend.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts -- --reporter=dot` — 59 passed
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/infra/session-cost-usage.ts src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main --codex-bin .artifacts/codex-flex` — clean, patch correct (0.84)
